{{Quote|Captain Valek, we're approaching Communications Research Station Epsilon Nine.|Unidentified Imperial ensign on board the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Revenant (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Revenant'']]|<ref name="Lumiya: Dark Star of the Empire">{{GalaxyCite|3|Lumiya: Dark Star of the Empire}}</ref>}}
'''Epsilon Nine''' was a [[Communications Research Station]] located in the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]] tasked with developing new [[spy satellite]]s for [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].<ref name="Lumiya: Dark Star of the Empire" />

After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] was defeated during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|final battle]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Space station/Legends|station]] attempted to defect to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] was dispatched by Imperial [[Regent/Legends|stewardess]] [[Ysanne Isard]] to travel to Epsilon Nine and [[Assault on Epsilon Nine|forcefully]] bring them back into Imperial jurisdiction.<ref name="Lumiya: Dark Star of the Empire" />

{{Station-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Epsilon Nine shares its name with the [[MemoryAlpha:Epsilon IX station|Epsilon IX station]], a communications monitoring and relay outpost in the first [[Memoryalpha:Star Trek|''Star Trek'']] film.
